description: Test the SGD group's other untested lever, which I048 deferred until the head axis was read. Head x0.5 cost 0.41 pp (E039) and head x2 gained 0.18 pp (E045), so the SGD group looks under-driven rather than over-driven. On the tip, change only the BatchNorm-bias lr multiplier from x64 to x128, and keep lr*wd constant for the BN biases by halving their wd. The head lr (x2), whitening-bias lr, Muon, lookahead, LS, curriculum, jitter and epochs stay identical. The lr is a 0-d tensor, so nothing recompiles and no new shapes are needed.
